The '''Red-pointed viper''' is a [[Poison/Legends|venomous]] [[Snake/Legends|serpent]] found in the jungles and swamps of [[Belkadan/Legends|Belkadan]]. Although not considered as life-threatening, at least not for [[trandoshan]]s, a red-pointed viper's venom causes nausea which can be cured with antidote. While hunting on Belkadan, trandoshan [[Qyzen Fess]] was bitten by a red-pointed viper which caused him sickness. He quickly approached [[Jedi Master]] [[Yuon Par]]'s camp where she offered him antivenom.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The red-pointed viper was first mentioned in Qyzen Fess' bio entry in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.
